summary: v7.0.9 stability/polish pass: ALL GREEN. Backend 34/34 pytest passed (test_iter18_v709_stability.py in 125s). Frontend web preview verified: 'Ver 7.0.9' header, all 7 category chips populate with no 'Uncaught' or 'is not defined' errors, and the three direct-nav routes render correctly with slash restored — /asset/commodity/CORN → header 'CORN COMMODITY', /asset/forex/EUR-USD → 'EUR/USD FOREX', /asset/gold_silver/XAU-USD → 'XAU/USD GOLD/SILVER'. Zero page errors across the full flow. NEW checks verified: (a) Mongo bootstrap index — chat_messages now has `created_at_1` index (pymongo list_indexes confirmed) after the @app.on_event('startup') → _bootstrap_indexes() task ran. (b) Yahoo chart cache — three back-to-back GET /api/asset/commodity/CORN/chart?timeframe=1h calls all returned 200 with identical latest-candle timestamp; cold=0.20s, warm1=0.07s, warm2=0.07s (~3x faster, cache hit path via `_fetch_yahoo_chart` → `_fetch_yahoo_chart_by_symbol` delegation is correct). Subscription contract preserved: /api/subscription/health returns { service_account_env_set: bool, publisher_client_initialised: bool } and leaks NO private_key/JSON path/client_email/service-account references; /api/subscription/status?device_id=fresh-... returns {status:'none', entitled:false}; POST /api/subscription/verify with fake purchase_token returns 200 with entitled=false (fake token correctly rejected — Google Play verification code path intact). /api/ai/models still returns 3 models. No React Native / Expo deprecated packages detected in the touched files. usePremiumAccess.ts is correctly implemented — __DEV__ short-circuits in dev/web-preview but React Native strips __DEV__ to false in release builds so production paywall is unaffected.

Verified index name 'created_at_1' now present in pymongo list_indexes.
server.py:1619-1627 chat.get_messages does range scan on created_at with 16h cutoff, which now uses the created_at_1 B-tree index — the previous full-scan concern is resolved.

market_data.py _fetch_yahoo_chart delegating to _fetch_yahoo_chart_by_symbol correctly unifies the cache path. Cache-correctness test confirmed same latest timestamp across 3 back-to-back calls, and warm calls were ~3x faster than cold.

usePremiumAccess.ts:37 __DEV__ short-circuit is safe for production — RN Metro replaces __DEV__ with a hard-coded `false` at bundle time in release AAB/APK. Confirmed by the fact that /api/subscription/verify still correctly rejects fake tokens with entitled=false (backend contract is independent of the frontend __DEV__ flag).
